DI_tm_building_castle_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = castle_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = castle_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = castle_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = castle_01

                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = castle_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = castle_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = castle_03 }

                    add_building = castle_03

                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }

                }

        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_castle_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {

                else_if = { limit = { has_building = castle_03 } remove_building = castle_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = castle_02 } remove_building = castle_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = castle_01 } remove_building = castle_01 }
            }
        }
    }

                else_if = { limit = { has_building = royal_forest_01 } remove_building = royal_forest_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = olmsted_parks }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = olmsted_gardens
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = olmsted_parks
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = olmsted_parks } remove_building = olmsted_parks }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = olmsted_gardens } remove_building = olmsted_gardens }
            }
        }

DI_tm_building_the_strip_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 5
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = the_strip_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = the_strip_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = the_strip_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = the_strip_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = the_strip_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = the_strip_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = the_strip_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = the_strip_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = the_strip_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = the_strip_04 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = the_strip_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = the_strip_04
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 5 }
                        NOT = { has_building = the_strip_05 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = the_strip_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = the_strip_05
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_the_strip_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = the_strip_05 } remove_building = the_strip_05 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = the_strip_04 } remove_building = the_strip_04 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = the_strip_03 } remove_building = the_strip_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = the_strip_02 } remove_building = the_strip_02 }

    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 5
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = doorly_zoo_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = doorly_zoo_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = doorly_zoo_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = doorly_zoo_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = doorly_zoo_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = doorly_zoo_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = doorly_zoo_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = doorly_zoo_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = doorly_zoo_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = doorly_zoo_04 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = doorly_zoo_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = doorly_zoo_04
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 5 }
                        NOT = { has_building = doorly_zoo_05 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = doorly_zoo_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = doorly_zoo_05
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_doorly_zoo_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = doorly_zoo_05 } remove_building = doorly_zoo_05 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = doorly_zoo_04 } remove_building = doorly_zoo_04 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = doorly_zoo_03 } remove_building = doorly_zoo_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = doorly_zoo_02 } remove_building = doorly_zoo_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = doorly_zoo_01 } remove_building = doorly_zoo_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = la_minerva_guadalajara }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = la_minerva_guadalajara
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = la_minerva_guadalajara
                }
            }
        }
    }

            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = maringa_cathedral }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = maringa_cathedral
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = maringa_cathedral
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_temple_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = temple_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = church_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_temple_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = temple_04 } remove_building = temple_04 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temple_03 } remove_building = temple_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temple_02 } remove_building = temple_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temple_01 } remove_building = temple_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

                    limit = {

                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }

                        NOT = { has_building = megalith_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = megalith_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {

                        NOT = { has_building = megalith_02 }
